comment:
* Writes sysui_multi_event records to the system event log.
 *
 * Prefer the methods write(LogMaker), or count() or histogram(). Replace legacy methods with
 * their current equivalents when the opportunity arises.
 *
 * This class is a lightweight dependency barrier - it is cheap and easy to construct.
 * Logging is also cheap, so it is not normally necessary to move logging off of the UI thread.
 *
 * @hide

methods.name: private static MetricsLogger getLogger()
protected void saveLog(LogMaker log)
public void write(LogMaker content)
methods.comment: Write an event log record, consisting of content.serialize().

methods.name: public void count(String name, int value)
methods.comment: Add an integer value to the monotonically increasing counter with the given name.

methods.name: public void histogram(String name, int bucket)
methods.comment: Increment the bucket with the integer label on the histogram with the given name.

methods.name: public void visible(int category) throws IllegalArgumentException
methods.comment:
Logs an OPEN event on the category.
     *  Equivalent to write(new LogMaker(category).setType(MetricsEvent.TYPE_OPEN))

methods.name: public void hidden(int category) throws IllegalArgumentException
methods.comment:
Logs a CLOSE event on the category.
     *  Equivalent to write(new LogMaker(category).setType(MetricsEvent.TYPE_CLOSE))

methods.name: public void visibility(int category, boolean visible) throws IllegalArgumentException
methods.comment:
Logs an OPEN or CLOSE event on the category, depending on visible.
     *  Equivalent to write(new LogMaker(category)
     *                     .setType(visible ? MetricsEvent.TYPE_OPEN : MetricsEvent.TYPE_CLOSE))

methods.name: public void visibility(int category, int vis) throws IllegalArgumentException
methods.comment:
Logs an OPEN or CLOSE event on the category, depending on vis.
     *  Equivalent to write(new LogMaker(category)
                           .setType(vis == View.VISIBLE ?
                                    MetricsEvent.TYPE_OPEN : MetricsEvent.TYPE_CLOSE))

methods.name: public void action(int category)
methods.comment:
Logs an ACTION event on the category.
     * Equivalent to write(new LogMaker(category).setType(MetricsEvent.TYPE_ACTION))

methods.name: public void action(int category, int value)
methods.comment:
Logs an ACTION event on the category.
     * Equivalent to write(new LogMaker(category).setType(MetricsEvent.TYPE_ACTION)
                           .setSubtype(value)

methods.name: public void action(int category, boolean value)
methods.comment:
Logs an ACTION event on the category.
     * Equivalent to write(new LogMaker(category).setType(MetricsEvent.TYPE_ACTION)
                           .setSubtype(value ? 1 : 0)

methods.name: public void action(int category, String pkg)
methods.comment:
Logs an ACTION event on the category.
     * Equivalent to write(new LogMaker(category).setType(MetricsEvent.TYPE_ACTION)
                           .setPackageName(value ? 1 : 0)
